query.template: Create a ranked bar chart for the top 15 fintech companies with `Headcount >= 50`, where the plotted value is `Total raised / Headcount` computed in `$M per employee`, using the section-3 `Total raised` and `Headcount` fields, sorted from highest to lowest capital intensity and excluding rows with `Headcount = N/A`.

Create a bubble chart for companies founded in `2020 or later`, where the x-axis is `years since founding` as of 2025, the y-axis is `Total raised / years since founding` in `$M per year`, bubble size is `Headcount`, and bubble color is `Commercial Maturity`, including only rows with numeric `Headcount` and numeric `Total raised`.

Create a dumbbell chart for the top 12 companies by absolute disagreement between `Mosaic percentile rank` and `Total raised percentile rank`, using all companies with numeric `Mosaic` and `Total raised`, with one endpoint showing each company’s rank by `Mosaic` and the other showing its rank by `Total raised`, sorted by the largest absolute rank gap.

Create a stacked bar chart showing the share of companies in each `Commercial Maturity` band (`1-2`, `3`, `4-5`, and `N/A`) for the founded-year cohorts `2012-2016`, `2017-2019`, and `2020-2024`, with each bar normalized to 100% of companies in that cohort.

Create a heatmap where rows are `Stage` families (`Seed`, `Series A`, `Series B`, `Series C+`, `Debt/Line of Credit`, `Other/Unattributed`) and columns are founded-year cohorts (`2012-2016`, `2017-2019`, `2020-2024`), with cell color showing the average `Mosaic` score for companies in each cell, using only rows with numeric `Mosaic`.

Create a ranked bar chart of `Stage` families by `share of total raised minus share of total companies`, using all rows with numeric `Total raised`, expressing the result in percentage points, sorted from the most overrepresented family to the most underrepresented family.

Create a bubble chart where each point is a `Stage` family, the x-axis is average `Headcount`, the y-axis is average `Mosaic`, and bubble size is that family’s share of total `Total raised`, using only rows with numeric `Headcount`, `Mosaic`, and `Total raised`.

Create a ranked bar chart for the top 12 companies by `Total raised / Commercial Maturity point`, using only companies with numeric `Commercial Maturity` and expressing the plotted value in `$M per maturity point`, sorted from highest to lowest.

Create a scatter plot for companies with `Mosaic >= 800`, where the x-axis is `Total raised / Headcount` in `$M per employee`, the y-axis is `years since founding`, bubble size is `Total raised`, and color encodes whether `Commercial Maturity` is `4-5`, `1-3`, or `N/A`.

Create a slope chart comparing, for each founded-year cohort (`2012-2016`, `2017-2019`, `2020-2024`), the cohort-average `Mosaic` score and the cohort-average `Commercial Maturity` rescaled to a `0-1000` range by multiplying the numeric maturity score by `200`, using only rows with numeric values for the relevant field.

Create a ranked bar chart for the top 10 directions by "high-quality deployment density," where the plotted value is the share of companies in each direction with Mosaic >= 800 and Commercial Maturity of at least 3 / 5, computed from the section-3 company tables, expressed as a percentage, sorted descending, and restricted to directions with at least 3 companies.

Create a bubble chart of the top 15 companies by Mosaic-per-$100M-raised, where the x-axis is Total raised in $M, the y-axis is Mosaic-per-$100M-raised, bubble size is Headcount, and color encodes direction, using only companies with numeric Total raised, Mosaic, and Headcount, sorted by the derived efficiency metric and limited to the top 15 companies.

Create a dumbbell chart comparing, for each super-group in the AI agent stack, its share of total companies versus its share of total disclosed funding, using the section-3 direction tables rolled up into the report's visible super-groups, with values expressed as percentages, sorted by the absolute gap between the two shares.

Create a scatter plot for directions with at least 4 companies, where the x-axis is median founded year, the y-axis is median Mosaic, point size is median Total raised in $M, and point color shows the share of companies in that direction with Commercial Maturity >= 4 / 5.

Create a heatmap showing, for each direction, the percentage of companies in each Commercial Maturity bucket from 1 / 5 through 5 / 5 plus N/A, restricted to directions with at least 3 companies, with directions sorted by the share of companies at 4 / 5 or 5 / 5 combined.

Create a ranked bar chart of the top 12 companies by "headcount-light quality," defined as Mosaic divided by Headcount, using only companies with disclosed Headcount and Mosaic, with values expressed as Mosaic points per employee, colored by direction, and excluding companies with Headcount below 10.

Create a slope chart comparing, for each super-group, its share of companies founded in 2023 or later against its share of total disclosed Mosaic points, with both values expressed as percentages and sorted by the difference between youth share and Mosaic share.

Create a scatter plot for the top 20 companies after filtering to Commercial Maturity >= 3 / 5 and disclosed funding, where the x-axis is company age in years, the y-axis is Mosaic, bubble size is Total raised in $M, and bubble color encodes whether the company belongs to Foundation models & infrastructure, Agent frameworks & development platforms, Tool integration, Context, Orchestration, or Oversight.

Create a stacked bar chart showing, for the top 8 directions by total disclosed funding, the percentage split of companies across stage families `early` (Seed, Pre-Seed, Seed VC, Series A), `mid` (Series B and Series C), `late` (Series D and later, Private Equity, Secondary Market, Corporate Minority, Loan, Grant, Option/Warrant, Convertible Note, Biz Plan, Spinoff / Spinout), and `other / unattributed`, with directions sorted by total disclosed funding in $M.

Create a dumbbell chart for the 12 companies with the largest mismatch between funding rank and Mosaic rank within their own direction, where the two endpoints are the within-direction rank by Total raised and the within-direction rank by Mosaic, limited to directions with at least 4 companies and companies with both values disclosed.

Create a bubble chart for the top 15 companies with disclosed valuations, where the x-axis is company age in years, the y-axis is Valuation in $M, bubble size is months since Last Funded, color encodes Stage family, and companies are restricted to those with both Valuation and Last Funded disclosed.

Create a ranked bar chart for the top 12 companies by valuation-per-year-since-founding, computed as Valuation in $M divided by company age in years, using only companies with disclosed Valuation and Founded year, sorted descending, with bars colored by whether Last Funded occurred in 2024 or earlier.

Create a dumbbell chart comparing, for each Stage family, the share of companies with disclosed Valuation versus the share with disclosed Last Funded, with values expressed as percentages and sorted by the absolute disclosure-gap between the two shares.

Create a heatmap showing valuation-disclosure rate by founded-year cohort and Stage family, where the plotted value is the percentage of companies in each cohort-stage cell with a disclosed Valuation, restricted to cells with at least 2 companies.

Create a scatter plot for companies with disclosed Valuation and Last Funded, where the x-axis is months since Last Funded, the y-axis is Valuation in $M, point size is company age in years, and points are colored by whether the company was founded before or after 2021, with all values shown as absolute values.

Create a stacked bar chart showing, for the top 8 founded-year cohorts by company count, the percentage composition of Stage families within each cohort, using counts of companies, expressed as percentages, and sorted by cohort size.

Create a ranked bar chart of the top 10 founded-year cohorts by median disclosed valuation in $M, restricted to cohorts with at least 3 companies that disclose valuation, sorted descending by the median valuation.

Create a dumbbell chart for the 12 companies with the largest gap between valuation rank and recency rank, where valuation rank is descending by Valuation in $M and recency rank is ascending by months since Last Funded, using only companies with both fields disclosed.

Create a bubble chart for the top 15 companies after filtering to Stage families with at least 5 companies, where the x-axis is company age in years, the y-axis is whether Valuation is disclosed as 1 for yes and 0 for no, bubble size is months since Last Funded, and color encodes Stage family, to show disclosure patterns by company maturity and funding recency.

Create a stacked bar chart comparing, for the top 6 Stage families by company count, the percentage split of companies across three funding-recency buckets `funded in 2024`, `funded in 2023`, and `funded before 2023 or undisclosed`, with percentages computed within each Stage family and Stage families sorted by company count.

Create a horizontal bar chart for the top 15 companies with at least `$10M` in `Total raised`, where the plotted value is `Mosaic per $10M raised`, computed as `Mosaic / (Total raised in $M / 10)`, expressed as `Mosaic points per $10M`, sorted descending, and colored by segment.

Create a bubble chart showing all companies with non-`N/A` `Commercial Maturity` and `Mosaic`, where the x-axis is `Commercial Maturity / 5`, the y-axis is `Mosaic / 1000`, bubble size is `Total raised` in `$M`, color encodes segment, and labels are shown only for the 12 companies with the largest positive gap between `Mosaic percentile rank` and `Total raised percentile rank`.

Create a dumbbell chart for the 12 companies whose `Mosaic rank` and `Total raised rank` differ the most within their own segment, with one endpoint showing segment-specific `Mosaic rank`, the other showing segment-specific `Total raised rank`, and the companies sorted by absolute rank gap descending.

Create a stacked bar chart showing, for each segment, the share of companies in three founder cohorts (`founded before 2015`, `2015-2019`, `2020 or later`) after filtering to companies with non-`N/A` `Founded year`, with bar segments expressed as percentages of companies inside each segment.

Create a scatter plot for companies founded in `2020 or later` with non-`N/A` `Total raised`, `Headcount`, and `Mosaic`, where the x-axis is `Total raised per employee` in `$M per employee`, the y-axis is `Mosaic`, points are colored by segment, and only the top 10 companies by `Total raised per employee` are labeled.

Create a heatmap showing `median Mosaic minus segment median Mosaic` for each combination of `segment` and `stage family`, where stage families are derived as `Seed/Pre-Seed`, `Series A-B`, `Series C+`, `Debt/Loan/Grant/Corporate/Other`, using only companies with non-`N/A` `Mosaic`, and expressing values in `Mosaic points`.

Create a ranked bar chart for the top 12 companies by `funding concentration per employee`, computed as `Total raised in $M / Headcount`, after filtering to companies with `Commercial Maturity >= 3 / 5`, non-`N/A` `Headcount`, and non-`N/A` `Total raised`, with bars grouped by segment.

Create a slope chart comparing each segment’s share of companies in the top quartile of `Mosaic` with its share of companies in the top quartile of `Total raised`, using only rows where both fields are available, and express the plotted values as percentages of qualifying companies.

Create a bubble chart for the top 20 companies by `Mosaic` with non-`N/A` `Founded year`, `Total raised`, and `Headcount`, where the x-axis is `company age` in years, the y-axis is `Headcount`, bubble size is `Total raised` in `$M`, and bubble color shows whether `Mosaic` is above or below the median of its segment.

Create a horizontal bar chart showing the top 10 companies by `maturity-adjusted Mosaic`, computed as `Mosaic / Commercial Maturity`, after excluding rows with `Commercial Maturity = N/A / 5` or `0`, expressing the value in `Mosaic points per maturity point`, and color the bars by segment.

Create a ranked horizontal bar chart for the top 10 markets by 2025 average funding per deal, computed as total 2025 funding divided by total 2025 deal count from the quarterly funding-and-deals tables, with funding expressed in `$M` per deal, sorted descending, and excluding parent geographies that have no directly comparable child-market peer set in the same chart.

Create a bubble chart for the top 12 markets by 2025 annual funding, where the x-axis is the top-5-deal concentration share in 2025 funding, the y-axis is the 2025 late-stage deal share, bubble size is total 2025 funding in `$B`, and markets are sorted for labeling by concentration share descending.

Create a dumbbell chart for the 10 markets with the largest 2024-to-2025 gap between funding growth and deal growth, where each market has one point for annual funding growth rate and one point for annual deal-count growth rate, both computed from summed yearly totals, expressed as percentages, sorted by the absolute divergence between the two growth rates.

Create a scatter plot of markets where the x-axis is 2025 early-stage deal share, the y-axis is 2025 average funding per deal in `$M`, and the bubble size is the sum of the market’s top 5 deal amounts in `$B`, restricted to markets with at least 100 total deals in 2025 and sorted for labels by bubble size descending.

Create a ranked bar chart showing the top 8 child markets by share of their parent geography’s 2025 annual funding, where the parent-child pairs are limited to the explicit hierarchy available in the report (for example `Silicon Valley` within `US`, `China` within `Asia`, `United Kingdom` within `Europe`, `Brazil` within `LatAm`), with values shown as percentages and sorted descending.

Create a slope chart comparing each market’s 2024 Q4 share of its own annual funding with its 2025 Q4 share of its own annual funding, for the 10 markets with the biggest increase in quarter-end concentration, with values shown as percentages and markets sorted by the size of the increase.

Create a heatmap for all markets showing the difference between 2025 funding share by quarter and 2025 deal share by quarter, where each cell is `(quarter funding / annual funding) minus (quarter deals / annual deals)`, expressed in percentage points, with rows sorted by the largest positive Q4 gap.

Create a ranked bar chart for the top 10 markets by headline-round amplification, where the metric is the largest single top-equity deal in 2025 divided by the market’s 2025 average funding per deal, expressed as a multiple, sorted descending, and restricted to markets whose top-deal summary includes at least one disclosed amount.

Create a scatter plot for markets where the x-axis is 2021-to-2025 CAGR of annual funding, the y-axis is 2021-to-2025 CAGR of annual deal count, and point color encodes 2025 late-stage deal share, restricted to markets with nonzero annual totals in both 2021 and 2025, with labels shown for the top 8 markets by absolute funding CAGR.

Create a bubble chart for the top 12 markets by 2025 annual funding where the x-axis is the percentage-point gap between early-stage share and late-stage share, the y-axis is the top-5-deal concentration share in annual funding, bubble size is annual deal count, and markets are sorted for labels by annual funding descending.

Create a ranked bar chart for the top 12 markets by `2025 YTD average funding per deal`, computed as `(2025 Q1 + Q2 + Q3 funding) / (2025 Q1 + Q2 + Q3 deals)`, expressed in `$M per deal`, filtered to markets with at least `50` total deals in `2025 YTD`, and sorted descending.

Create a bubble chart for all markets where the x-axis is `2025 YTD top-deal concentration share`, computed as `sum of the visible Top 5 equity deal amounts / total 2025 YTD funding`, the y-axis is `2025 YTD average funding per deal`, bubble size is total `2025 YTD funding` in `$B`, and points are labeled only for the top 10 markets by concentration share.

Create a slope chart comparing each market’s `average funding per deal` in `2024 Q1-Q3` versus `2025 Q1-Q3`, expressed in `$M per deal`, after filtering to markets that have complete data in both periods and at least `40` deals in `2025 Q1-Q3`, and sort the lines by the 2025 value.

Create a ranked bar chart showing the 10 markets with the largest `2025 YTD stage-capital mismatch`, defined as `Top 5 equity deal concentration share minus Late-stage deal share`, with values expressed in percentage points and sorted descending.

Create a scatter plot for all markets with complete `2024 Q1-Q3` and `2025 Q1-Q3` data, where the x-axis is `funding growth rate` from `2024 Q1-Q3` to `2025 Q1-Q3`, the y-axis is `deal growth rate` over the same period, bubble size is `2025 YTD funding` in `$B`, and color encodes whether the market’s `Early-stage` share is above or below `75%`.

Create a dumbbell chart for US ecosystems (`Silicon Valley`, `New York`, `Los Angeles`, `Boston`, `Seattle`, `Austin`, `Miami`, `Philadelphia`) showing each market’s share of `US 2025 YTD funding` versus its share of `US 2025 YTD deals`, expressed as percentages, and sort by the largest positive funding-share minus deal-share gap.

Create a ranked bar chart for the top 10 markets by `headline-round amplification`, computed as `largest visible top equity deal amount / 2025 YTD average funding per deal`, expressed as a multiple, after filtering to markets with at least `20` total deals in `2025 YTD`.

Create a heatmap showing, for each market, the difference in `average funding per deal` between adjacent periods (`2021`, `2022`, `2023`, `2024`, `2025 YTD`), where each cell is the period-over-period change in `$M per deal`, and limit the rows to the 15 markets with the largest absolute change from `2024` to `2025 YTD`.

Create a bubble chart comparing markets by `2025 YTD top-5 deal concentration share` on the x-axis and `Early-stage minus Late-stage deal share` on the y-axis, with bubble size equal to `2025 YTD deal count`, expressed in percentage points for the y-axis, and label only markets whose concentration share is above `40%`.

Create a horizontal bar chart for the top 10 markets by `share of global 2025 YTD funding minus share of global 2025 YTD deals`, expressed in percentage points, after computing both shares from the 2025 Q1-Q3 totals and sorting descending.

Create a ranked bar chart for the top 12 markets by 2025 average funding per deal, computed from summed 2025 quarterly funding divided by summed 2025 quarterly deal count, with values expressed in `$M` per deal, sorted descending, and excluding parent geographies that are only valid as denominators in hierarchy analysis.

Create a bubble chart for all four Sector Spotlights where the x-axis is the 2025 top-10-deal concentration share in annual sector funding, the y-axis is the 2025 late-stage deal share, and bubble size is the sector’s annual 2025 funding in `$B`, sorted by concentration share descending.

Create a dumbbell chart for the 10 markets with the largest 2024-to-2025 divergence between funding growth and deal growth, where one endpoint is annual funding growth rate and the other is annual deal-count growth rate, both in percentages, sorted by the absolute gap between them.

Create a scatter plot for the four Sector Spotlights where the x-axis is 2025 annual average deal size, the y-axis is 2025 annual median deal size, bubble size is the sector’s Q4’25 top-deal concentration share in annual funding, and points are labeled with the sector name.

Create a slope chart comparing each sector’s 2024 average deal size with its 2025 average deal size, restricted to the four Sector Spotlights, with values in `$M`, and sort sectors by 2025 average deal size descending.

Create a scatter plot for the top 15 markets by 2025 annual funding where the x-axis is the gap between early-stage share and late-stage share in percentage points, the y-axis is the largest visible top-equity-deal amount divided by annual average deal size, and bubble size is annual deal count, sorted for labels by annual funding descending.

Create a heatmap for all markets showing the percentage-point difference between each quarter’s share of 2025 annual funding and the same quarter’s share of 2025 annual deal count, with rows sorted by the largest positive Q4 gap and columns ordered Q1 to Q4.

Create a ranked lollipop chart for the top 10 markets by 2025 top-deal concentration share, defined as the sum of the visible Q4’25 top-equity-deal amounts divided by the market’s full-year 2025 funding, with values shown as percentages and sorted descending.

Create a bubble chart comparing sectors and markets in the same view after filtering to entities with complete 2025 stage-mix and top-deal coverage, where the x-axis is 2025 average funding per deal, the y-axis is top-deal concentration share, bubble size is annual 2025 funding in `$B`, and point color distinguishes `Sector` versus `Market`.

Create a ranked bar chart for the top 12 markets by `2025 YTD average funding per deal`, computed as `(Q1+Q2+Q3 2025 funding) / (Q1+Q2+Q3 2025 deals)`, with values expressed in `$M per deal`, sorted from highest to lowest, and excluding any market with missing quarterly inputs.

Create a bubble chart where each sector spotlight is plotted by `top-3 Q3’25 deal concentration share` on the x-axis and `2025 YTD early-stage share` on the y-axis, with bubble size equal to `2025 YTD funding` in `$B`, using only the `AI`, `Fintech`, `Retail Tech`, `Digital Health`, and `CVC` sector rows.

Create a slope chart comparing each sector’s `2024 full-year average deal size` with its `2025 YTD average deal size`, both in `$M per deal`, sorted by the largest positive change from 2024 to 2025 YTD.

Create a scatter plot for all markets showing `Q3’25 funding growth rate versus Q3’25 deal growth rate`, where each growth rate is measured against `Q3’24`, bubble size is `Q3’25 funding` in `$B`, and points are colored by whether the market is a parent geography or a child market.

Create a ranked bar chart for the top 10 markets by `Q3’25 top-deal concentration share`, computed as `sum of the top 5 Q3’25 deal amounts / Q3’25 total funding`, with the value shown as a percentage and the chart limited to markets whose top-deal list has at least 5 visible deals.

Create a dumbbell chart for the sectors `AI`, `Fintech`, `Retail Tech`, `Digital Health`, and `CVC`, comparing each sector’s `2025 YTD late-stage share` with its `Q3’25 top-5 deal concentration share`, both shown as percentages and sorted by the largest positive gap between concentration and late-stage share.

Create a ranked bar chart for the top 8 US child markets by `Q3’25 acceleration`, where acceleration is defined as `(Q3’25 funding growth rate vs Q3’24) minus (Q3’25 deal growth rate vs Q3’24)`, expressed in percentage points and limited to `New York`, `Los Angeles`, `Boston`, `Seattle`, `Denver`, `Chicago`, `Dallas`, `Austin`, `Miami`, `Atlanta`, `Philadelphia`, and `Raleigh`.

Create a bubble chart for all sector spotlights where the x-axis is `2025 YTD average deal size / 2025 YTD median deal size` as a multiple, the y-axis is `Q3’25 top-5 deal concentration share`, bubble size is `2025 YTD funding` in `$B`, and bubble color indicates whether `early-stage share` is above or below 65%.

Create a ranked bar chart for the top 10 markets by `headline-round amplification`, defined as `largest Q3’25 top equity deal / Q3’25 average deal size`, where `Q3’25 average deal size` is computed as `Q3’25 funding / Q3’25 deals`, values are expressed as multiples, and only markets with at least one visible top equity deal are included.

Create a scatter plot for sectors where the x-axis is `2025 YTD median deal size` in `$M`, the y-axis is `Q3’25 funding growth rate vs Q3’24`, bubble size is `Q3’25 top-5 deal concentration share`, and bubble color indicates whether the sector’s `early-stage share` is above or below the cross-sector median.

Create a ranked bar chart for the top 15 companies by `IPO readiness efficiency`, defined as `IPO probability divided by Total raised`, with `Total raised` normalized to `$B`, shown as `IPO-probability points per $1B raised`, filtered to companies with numeric `Total raised`, and sorted descending by the derived metric.

Create a bubble chart of the top 20 companies after ranking by `IPO probability minus Mosaic rank percentile`, where the x-axis is `Mosaic score`, the y-axis is `IPO probability (%)`, bubble size is `Headcount`, and only companies with numeric `Headcount` are included.

Create a dumbbell chart for the top 12 companies with the largest difference between `IPO probability rank` and `Commercial Maturity rank`, where one end of each dumbbell is the IPO-probability rank and the other is the Commercial-Maturity rank, limited to companies with numeric maturity scores and sorted by absolute rank gap.

Create a stacked bar chart showing, by founded-year cohort (`2000-2009`, `2010-2014`, `2015-2019`, `2020+`), the share of companies that fall into three IPO-probability bands: below `20%`, `20%-39.9%`, and `40%+`, with cohort bars sorted by the cohort’s average IPO probability.

Create a scatter plot for the top 25 companies by `scale-adjusted IPO readiness`, where the plotted value is `IPO probability divided by log10(Headcount)`, the x-axis is `Total raised ($B)`, the y-axis is that derived readiness metric, color encodes `Commercial Maturity`, and points are restricted to companies with numeric `Headcount` and `Total raised`.

Create a ranked horizontal bar chart for the top 10 companies by `Mosaic-to-IPO mismatch`, defined as the absolute difference between each company’s `Mosaic rank percentile` and `IPO probability percentile`, with values shown in percentile points and sorted descending.

Create a bubble chart comparing the top 15 companies founded in 2015 or later, where the x-axis is `Headcount per $100M raised`, the y-axis is `IPO probability`, bubble size is `Mosaic`, and points are colored by whether `Commercial Maturity` is below 5 or equal to 5.

Create a slope chart comparing each founded-year cohort’s share of all pipeline companies with its share of the pipeline’s total disclosed funding, using cohorts `pre-2010`, `2010-2014`, `2015-2019`, and `2020+`, with funding converted to `$B` and cohorts sorted by the increase from company share to funding share.

Create a scatter plot for the top 20 companies after filtering to `Commercial Maturity = 5 / 5`, where the x-axis is `Total raised ($B)`, the y-axis is `IPO probability (%)`, point size is `Headcount`, and point color shows whether `Mosaic` is above or below the median Mosaic of the filtered set.

Create a ranked bar chart for the top 12 companies by `IPO probability per 1,000 employees`, using companies with numeric `Headcount`, with values shown as `percentage points of IPO probability per 1,000 employees`, sorted descending by the derived metric.

Create a ranked horizontal bar chart for the top 15 companies in the report by capital efficiency, where capital efficiency is `Mosaic score divided by Total raised` converted to `Mosaic points per $100M raised`, using only companies with numeric `Total raised`, sorted descending by that derived metric, and excluding rows where `Total raised` is `N/A`.

Create a bubble chart for companies with numeric `Headcount` and numeric `Total raised`, where the x-axis is `Total raised ($M)`, the y-axis is `Mosaic score`, bubble size is `Headcount`, and color encodes `Commercial Maturity`, then label only the 12 companies with the largest positive gap between `Mosaic rank` and `Total raised rank`.

Create a stacked bar chart comparing value-chain segments by the share of companies in each segment that fall into three maturity buckets, `Commercial Maturity 2 or below`, `Commercial Maturity 3 to 4`, and `Commercial Maturity 5`, where segment membership is inferred from the report’s section-2 page blocks and duplicate company cards are counted only once.

Create a dumbbell chart showing, for each value-chain segment with at least five companies, the gap between that segment’s share of all companies and its share of all disclosed funding, using `Total raised` converted to `$B`, with segments sorted by the absolute size of the gap.

Create a scatter plot for the top 20 youngest companies by `Founded year`, where the x-axis is `Headcount per $100M raised`, the y-axis is `Mosaic score`, point color shows segment, and points are limited to companies founded in 2020 or later with numeric `Headcount` and `Total raised`.

Create a heatmap with value-chain segments on rows and funding-stage families on columns, where each cell shows the average `Mosaic score` for companies in that segment-stage combination, using stage-family normalization such as `equity VC`, `debt/loan/credit`, `grant/corporate`, and `N/A/other`, and include only cells with at least two companies.

Create a ranked bar chart of the top 10 companies by `Mosaic momentum`, defined as the one-year Mosaic change divided by `Founded age in years`, using only companies with numeric Mosaic change and numeric Founded year, with values shown as `Mosaic-change points per company-year`.

Create a slope chart comparing each value-chain segment’s share of all companies founded in or after 2020 against its share of all companies with `Mosaic >= 850`, counting each company once and sorting segments by the increase from founder-share to high-Mosaic-share.

Create a bubble chart for the top 12 companies after filtering to rows with numeric `Total raised`, `Headcount`, and `Mosaic`, where the plotted value is `Mosaic score minus the company’s funding-rank percentile`, the x-axis is `Headcount`, the y-axis is that derived gap score, bubble size is `Total raised ($M)`, and color shows whether `Commercial Maturity` is below 4, equal to 4, or equal to 5.

Create a ranked bar chart for the top 8 value-chain segments by `top-3 funding concentration`, where concentration is the share of each segment’s disclosed funding captured by its three most-funded companies, using company-to-segment assignment from section-2 page ranges, with values shown as percentages and segments sorted descending by concentration.

Create a ranked horizontal bar chart showing the top 10 main industries in the 2025 report by `single-country score share`, where the plotted value is `the sum of scores contributed by the highest-scoring country in each main industry divided by that industry's visible top-20 score total`, values are expressed as percentages, only the 11 main industries on pages 15-25 are included, and bars are sorted from highest to lowest after the ratio is computed.

Create a ranked horizontal bar chart comparing all 11 main industries by `tail-depth ratio`, defined as `the sum of scores for ranks 6-10 divided by the sum of scores for ranks 1-5` within each main industry, with values shown as percentages, using only pages 15-25, and sort the industries from highest to lowest after the ratio is derived.

Create a bubble chart for the 11 main industries in the 2025 report where the x-axis is `the number of distinct countries represented in the visible top-20 list`, the y-axis is `single-country score share` computed as `highest country subtotal divided by visible industry total`, bubble size represents `visible top-20 industry score total`, all y-values are percentages, and industry labels are shown directly on the points.

Create a ranked dumbbell chart for the matched parent-subindustry pairs in the report, where each pair compares `top-3 score share inside the subindustry list` versus `top-3 score share inside its parent industry list`, the plotted value is the percentage-point increase from parent to subindustry, parent-child pairs are limited to those explicitly visible on pages 15-25 and 27-36, and the pairs are sorted from the largest positive increase to the smallest.

Create a ranked horizontal bar chart showing the top 12 countries by `breadth efficiency`, where the metric is `visible country-list score total divided by the number of distinct industries represented in that country's visible company list`, values are expressed in score points per represented industry, countries must have at least 5 visible companies on pages 38-67, and bars are sorted from highest to lowest after the ratio is computed.

Create a bubble chart for countries that have at least 8 visible companies in the country tables, where the x-axis is `the number of distinct industries represented`, the y-axis is `flagship dependence` computed as `the top-ranked company score divided by the country's visible total score`, bubble size represents `the country's visible total score`, y-values are percentages, and country labels are shown for all plotted bubbles.

Create a ranked horizontal bar chart showing the top 12 countries by `leaderboard capture ratio`, where the metric is `the sum of scores from country-list companies that also appear in at least one main-industry top-20 table divided by that country's visible total score`, values are percentages, countries must have at least 5 visible companies in their country table, and bars are sorted descending after the cross-view match is completed.

Create a ranked horizontal bar chart showing the top 10 countries by `visible industry leadership rate`, where the metric is `the number of main industries in which the country supplies the rank-1 company divided by the number of main industries in which that country appears anywhere in the visible top 20`, values are percentages, only the 11 main industries on pages 15-25 are used, and countries are sorted from highest to lowest after the ratio is derived.
